page.content:
Jutland town that is LEGO's hometown and factory seat.

How Billund connects

  • Faction: The LEGO Group — The LEGO Group is headquartered in Billund.
  • Character: Ole Kirk Christiansen — Ole Kirk Christiansen built the first LEGO workshop in Billund.
  • Location: Legoland Billund — Legoland Billund stands in the same town as the factory.

What is Billund?

Billund, Denmark, is where Ole Kirk's workshop stood, where The LEGO Group still headquarters, and where Legoland Billund opened as a brick-built park beside the factory.

Key threads lead to The LEGO Group, Ole Kirk Christiansen and Legoland Billund.
